attestation_keys.description: Cold-storage authority surface for emergency key events. Sorted by raw public-key bytes ascending in canonical bytes; deduplicated. Disjoint from initial_key. See ACTORS.md §5.5.2.

attestation_threshold.description: M of the M-of-N quorum required to sign any attestation-surface emergency event. MUST satisfy 1 <= attestation_threshold <= attestation_keys.length. Always explicit; no default. See ACTORS.md §5.5.3.

created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No fractional seconds; no offsets other than Z.

nonce.description: Thirty-two random bytes encoded as lowercase hex.

bytes.description: Raw ed25519 public key bytes encoded with standard base64.
